title: Discovery Children's Museum

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Come play and learn with us this summer! Bring your curiosity and sense of wonder as you join Museum Educators for brain-boosting camps that focus on STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math) activities! With a diverse range of camps tailored for curious minds of all ages, DISCOVERY Children’s Museum is your destination for educational summer fun! Whether they’re budding scientists, aspiring artists, or future engineers, there’s a place for every curious mind at DISCOVERY Children’s Museum. services.desc: Whether you are a longtime member or looking to book your family’s first visit, we are committed to making sure your experience is both memorable and safe. All patrons ages 1 and up require an admission ticket for entry. Visitors under the age of 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Online tickets purchased through a non-Museum 3rd party partner may not be accepted. Admission for patrons with a valid EBT, SNAP, or WIC card (P-EBT and Summer EBT are not accepted). Cards must be presented at entry for verification. ONLY valid for 4 tickets per adult cardholder. Valid for in-person purchase

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: DISCOVERY Children’s Museum provides hands-on STEAM educational experiences that can’t be replicated inside a classroom (or anywhere else in town for that matter). These immersive exhibits are aligned with the Nevada State Content Standards, Common Core and Next Generation Science Standards. This enables students to explore curricular concepts in new and interactive ways, while still meeting the curriculum goals of your class room. Teachers, supplement those rockstar lesson plans with a hands-on, interactive, field trip to DISCOVERY!
